question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Someone who does not believe that God exists
solution:
The solution is **Atheist.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The option that can be used as a one-word substitute for 'Someone who does not believe that God exists' is **Atheist.**
 
• Therefore **option 2 **is the correct option.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information about other options:
 
 
• **Devotee - **A strong believer in a particular religion or god.

 
 
• For example:- *"Devotee of jesus"*
 
 
 
• *​***Priest - **A person that performs the sacred rites of a religion especially as a mediatory agent between humans and gods.
 
 
• For example:- *"The priest performed a ceremony to worship god"*
 
 
 
• ​**Nun - **A member of a religion community of women, typically one living under vows of poverty, chastity, and obedience.
 
 
• For example:- *"A nun used to look after me when I was an orphan."*
